predecessors.name: Landgraviate of Hesse-Kassel
predecessors.text: the Landgraviate of Hesse-Kassel, 'raised to the dignity of Prince-elector' in 1803 and 'compensated ... with some former French territory around Mainz'

successors.name: Kingdom of Prussia
successors.text: the whole Electorate: 'By the Peace of Prague, Hesse-Kassel was annexed to Prussia'; it became part of the Province of Hesse-Nassau, formed by Royal Decree of 7 December 1868

ledger.x: 1803: William I of Hesse-Kassel is made Prince-elector.
1807: the occupation of this land becomes annexation.
1807: Hesse-Kassel goes into the Kingdom of Westphalia.
1810: the Hanau lands pass from French occupation to the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt.
1810: Hanau is incorporated into the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt, a French satellite.
1813: Hesse-Cassel's sovereignty over Hanau is restored.
21 November 1813: the Elector returns to Kassel.
1815: the Congress of Vienna gives Fulda to Hesse.

c. 1820: the rest of the eastern and Rhine-Main lands. Cliopatria's shape grows from 10,530 to 13,815 km2 in 1820; Fulda and the Hanau lands explain most of the rise, and what remains is about seven cells (some 1,800 km2) that no page opened dates or names. Pages…

wars.name: War of the Fourth Coalition
wars.outcome: Hesse-Kassel, neutral by its 1806 treaty, was occupied and expelled by Napoleon and annexed to the Kingdom of Westphalia at Tilsit (1807).

wars.name: War of the Sixth Coalition
wars.outcome: After the Battle of Leipzig the French were driven out; the Elector returned to Kassel on 21 November 1813 and the Congress of Vienna restored the Electorate.

wars.name: Austro-Prussian War
wars.outcome: The elector sided with Austria; Prussia occupied Kassel on 20 June 1866 and annexed Hesse-Kassel by the Peace of Prague.

certainty.note: No page opened gives boundary lines; the 1803 Mainz-area gain is unlocated and 1806-1813 the state held no land (Hanau was under French occupation to 1810, then in the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt, restored 1813).
Frontiers after the Congress of Vienna settlement are treaty lines, though no page opened lists them; the Hanau, Fulda and Schmalkalden edges and the western exclaves are less certain than the core.
